# Fenjue (焚诀)

> Multi-agent unified memory & skill-routing governance framework: one shared memory source, a
> four-layer skill router (direct → tag → semantic → memory), quantified lessons/skill hit rates,
> attention-budget ratchets, and truth-consistency gates that compare prose against a single
> machine-readable source of truth. This repository is the **public subset** — no personal memory
> corpus, session logs, skill bodies or model weights.

Agent skills are validated before publication by two content gates: zero-tolerance prompt-injection /
credential-exfiltration scanning (`skill_security_scan`) and frontmatter conformance to the agentskills
spec — description ≤1024 chars, required fields, frozen field whitelist (`skill_publish_compliance`).
Those two gates live in the private source repository; in this subset the equivalent shipped gate is
`scripts/public_clean_check.py` (with a drillable `--selftest`).

## Claims you can recompute from a clean clone

- Hit rate, tiered: `python eval/hitrate_cli.py --skills-dir examples/skills --queries examples/queries.json --top 3`
- Scale behaviour (index time / per-query latency / peak allocation): `python eval/bench_router.py --sizes 12,100,500,1000`
- Test suite: `python -m pytest` (do **not** append `-q`: `addopts` in `pyproject.toml` already
  carries `-q`, and a second one makes it `-qq`, which suppresses the `N passed, M skipped` line
  the CI parity gate parses — measured 2026-09-29: `pytest` ⇒ `655 passed, 49 skipped`,
  `pytest -q` ⇒ no counts line at all)
- Endpoint count: length of `endpoints.active` in `eval/truth_constants.json`, asserted against prose by `python eval/doc_claim_face.py`
- Documentation link integrity on shipped root docs: `python eval/check_doc_links.py`
- MCP surface for agents: `python eval/mcp_server.py` (needs the optional `mcp>=2.2,<3` extra), or
  `python eval/fenjue_cli.py mcp-config --client claude` to emit a paste-ready config
- Whole-tool self-check in one command: `python eval/fenjue_cli.py doctor` (one rc per entry of `CHECKS`
  in `eval/fenjue_cli.py` — the count is read from the roster, not kept by hand, so adding a check cannot
  leave a stale number here;
  missing carriers are reported as skipped-with-reason and never count as passing)
- Worked usage cases with recomputation commands: [docs/CASE_STUDY.md](docs/CASE_STUDY.md)

## Installed commands (after `python -m pip install .`)

Every console script below is read live from `[project.scripts]` in `pyproject.toml`; the CI step
`Command face parity` fails if this file stops listing any of them, so the list cannot silently rot.

- `fenjue` — one entrypoint for everything; subcommands are `route`, `eval`, `bench`, `mcp`,
  `hitrate`, `doctor`, `mcp-config`, plus `--version`
- `fenjue-hitrate` — tiered hit-rate report (same engine as `python eval/hitrate_cli.py`)
- `fenjue-bench` — scale benchmark (same engine as `python eval/bench_router.py`)
- `fenjue-mcp` — MCP stdio server for agent integration

All four are verified **from outside the repository** (cwd = a temp directory) on every push by the
`install-face` job, so "installed but not runnable" cannot pass CI.
